security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU TCG, if the decoder disambiguates PMULHR.W and MULHR incorrectly due to their identical encoding (both OP-32, funct2=0x3, funct4=0x0, bit[25]=0x1), or if PMULH.W/PMULHR.W are not gated behind RV64-only checks (causing illegal-op on RV32 to be missed or wrong op on RV64), guest code executing one instruction gets the other instruction's semantics — producing silently wrong packed vs. scalar multiply-high results in the destination register.
security_spec.summary: Encoding collision between PMULHR.W and MULHR (both funct2=0x3, funct4=0x0 in OP-32) creates ambiguous decode; PMULH.W/PMULHR.W require RV64-only guards; TCG translation must correctly extract upper-half of double-width intermediate products with proper signed/unsigned zero-extension and rounding-constant width matching XLEN

findings.finding: Only standard RVM mulh/mulhsu/mulhu (opcode 0110011), RV64M mulw variants (opcode 0111011), and RV128M (opcode 1111011) are defined. No P-ext opcode 1101011 exists, no PMULH.W/PMULHR.W instructions, no funct2=0x3/funct4=0x0/bit[25]=0x1 decode ambiguity possible because the instructions do not exist in the decoder.

No ext_zpn, ext_zps, ext_zpn32, ext_zpn64, ext_zpnh, ext_zpnb, or ext_pext config flags exist. Without these, no P-ext functionality can be gated or enabled, so the decoder ambiguity between PMULHR.W and MULHR cannot be triggered.

The RV32/RV64 disambiguation uses opcode-based separation (0110011 vs 0111011 vs 1111011) plus gen_arith_per_ol() width selection. No decode_op32 function exists. The standard M-extension mulh instructions are correctly disambiguated with no path to P-ext opcode 1101011.

Standard M-extension mulh translation: gen_mulh_w implements 32-bit multiply-high via tcg_gen_muls2_tl + tcg_gen_sari_tl shift by 32. This is correct scalar multiply-high, not packed SIMD. No P-ext packed multiply-high (which would extract half-words and multiply separately) exists.
gen_mulhsu_w correctly sign-extends s1 to 64-bit, zero-extends s2, multiplies, then shifts right by 32. This is the correct scalar mulhsu semantics, not packed SIMD.
Unrelated IOMMU fix: adds validation that when GATP is in BARE mode, MSI translation must also be OFF. Not related to P-ext multiply-high instructions. No security issue.
